from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess

root = Path('/workspace/Anamorph')
base = Path('/workspace/scratch/anamorph-integration207208/nr025-controls')
base.mkdir()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native', root/'scripts/native_validation.py')
native = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(native)
commands = [native.command_args(s, False) for s in subprocess.check_output(
    ['ninja', '-C', str(root/'build'), '-t', 'commands', 'AnamorphStateTests'], text=True).splitlines() if s.strip()]
edit = [c for c in commands if '-c' in c and any(s.endswith('/src/PluginEditor.cpp') for s in c)
        and 'AnamorphStateTests.dir' in native.output_path(c)]
assert len(edit) == 1
old = native.output_path(edit[0])
links = [c for c in commands if '-c' not in c and old in c]
assert len(links) == 1
fixed = (root/'src/PluginEditor.cpp').read_text()
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '29150f312ec4a43ec85f35e61028d8338057d927:src/PluginEditor.cpp'], cwd=root, text=True)
menu = '    if (menuAlive == nullptr) return; // NR-025: latency notification can destroy this editor'
timer = '    if (timerAlive == nullptr) return;'
assert fixed.count(menu) == fixed.count(timer) == 1
raw = '    presetName.onClick = [this] { showPresetMenu(); };'
start = fixed.index('    presetName.onClick = [weak =')
end = fixed.index('    addAndMakeVisible (presetPrev);', start)
variants = {
    'fixed': (fixed, ['menu-close', 'timer-close', 'timer-live', 'popup-live']),
    'original': (original, ['menu-close', 'timer-close']),
    'remove-menu-guard': (fixed.replace(menu, '    // Negative control: missing post-adoption menu guard.'), ['menu-close']),
    'remove-timer-guard': (fixed.replace(timer, '    // Negative control: missing post-poll timer guard.'), ['timer-close']),
    'raw-stale-callback': (fixed[:start] + raw + '\n' + fixed[end:], ['menu-close']),
    'return-before-popup': (fixed.replace(menu, '    return; // Negative control: suppress every popup.'), ['popup-live']),
    'return-before-timer-update': (fixed.replace(timer, '    return; // Negative control: suppress every timer refresh.'), ['timer-live']),
}
records = []
for name, (source, cases) in variants.items():
    out = base/name; out.mkdir()
    src = out/'PluginEditor.cpp'; src.write_text(source)
    cmd = native.with_output([str(src) if s.endswith('/src/PluginEditor.cpp') else s for s in edit[0]], out/'editor.o')
    cmd += ['-O1', '-g', '-fsanitize=address', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=root/'build', stdout=(out/'compile.stdout').open('wb'), stderr=(out/'compile.stderr').open('wb'))
    assert r.returncode == 0, name
    link = native.with_output([str(out/'editor.o') if s == old else s for s in links[0]], out/'AnamorphStateTests') + ['-fsanitize=address']
    r = subprocess.run(link, cwd=root/'build', stdout=(out/'link.stdout').open('wb'), stderr=(out/'link.stderr').open('wb'))
    assert r.returncode == 0, name
    record = {'variant': name, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'commands': [cmd, link], 'results': []}
    for case in cases:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env['ASAN_OPTIONS'] = 'detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1:symbolize=1'
        env['XDG_CONFIG_HOME'] = str(out/('profile-'+case))
        sym = subprocess.run(['which', 'llvm-symbolizer'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if sym.returncode == 0: env['ASAN_SYMBOLIZER_PATH'] = sym.stdout.strip()
        invocation = [str(out/'AnamorphStateTests'), '--gui-restore-lifetime-probe', case]
        if case == 'popup-live': invocation = ['xvfb-run', '-a'] + invocation
        r = subprocess.run(invocation, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=(out/(case+'.stdout')).open('wb'), stderr=(out/(case+'.stderr')).open('wb'))
        err = (out/(case+'.stderr')).read_text()
        result = {'case': case, 'exit': r.returncode, 'heap_use_after_free': 'heap-use-after-free' in err,
                  'asan_error': 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in err,
                  'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256((out/(case+'.stdout')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256((out/(case+'.stderr')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        record['results'].append(result)
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'variant': name, 'results': record['results']}), flush=True)
    records.append(record)
packet = {'baseline': '29150f312ec4a43ec85f35e61028d8338057d927',
          'scope': 'Actual Editor TU instrumented. Current complete state driver and other objects unchanged. Not full-suite instrumentation.',
          'fixture_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root/'tests/gui_restore_lifetime_tests.h').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'variants': records}
(base/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(packet, indent=2)+'\n')
assert all(x['exit'] == 0 and not x['asan_error'] for x in records[0]['results'])
assert all(x['exit'] != 0 and x['heap_use_after_free'] for r in records[1:5] for x in r['results'])
assert all(x['exit'] == 1 and not x['asan_error'] for r in records[5:] for x in r['results'])
